title: Swap and Negate
statement: The task is to maximise the sum of n integers (n up to 2·10^5) when an operation may replace an adjacent pair (a_i, a_{i+1}) with (-a_{i+1}, -a_i). Multiplying each a_i by (-1)^i turns the operation into a plain swap, so by a parity argument an element's final sign depends only on whether its index parity changes; equally many odd-index and even-index elements get negated, chosen greedily after sorting.
